'''Balmorran puppet government''' was the government set up by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] after their victory over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The government was made up of local collaborators who helped the Imperial forces in conquering the largest [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The positions in governmental institutions and nationalized factories/plants were forms of reward for their "loyal" service for the empire. The puppet government was much hated by the [[Balmorran resistance]], because many of its members had been involved in war crimes resulting even in the death of innocent civilian population.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] there was spy network of secret collaborators working for the Sith Empire and its puppet government against the resistance movement. The list containing the names of these traitors was a vital objective for the Balmorran resistance war effort.

[[Brel Orus]] was one of the most notorious corporate managers who were rewarded with a cushy position in the puppet government for his collaboration.
